description.content: Operations for retrieving works by editor

Retrieves the bibliographic metadata for each bibliographic entity edited by the person identified by the given ORCID or OpenCitations Meta Identifier (OMID).
Fields returned: id, title, author, pub_date, issue, volume, venue, page, type, publisher, editor.

query.description: Removes rows with empty values in the specified field
Applies conditional filtering. Supports regex or operators (=, <, >). Format: field:operator:value. Example: date:>2015
Orders results by field in ascending or descending order. Format: asc(field) or desc(field).
Transforms JSON data structure. Supports array splitting or dict conversion.

variable.description: (Required) ORCID or OMID of the editor. Example: orcid:0000-0003-2098-4759

info.name: OpenCitations Index REST Authors Editors API

description.content:
REST API for accessing the data stored in the OpenCitations Index. Provides operations to retrieve citation data for references to other works appearing in a particular bibliographic entity, or citation data for references in other works to a particular bibliographic entity, given the identifier of a bibliographic entity, or to retrieve citation data about a particular citation identified by means of its Open Citation Identifier (OCI).
All operations return either a JSON document (default) or a CSV document according to the mimetype specified in the Accept header of the request.
API calls are rate-limited to 180 requests/minute per IP address. For large-scale retrieval use the database dumps at download.opencitations.net.
